title: ToastsBows
body:
Add 6 more bows and 1 more quiver.

6 bows'ability are as follows:

Daedalus summons 3 arrows from 5blocks upside.

Beeshoney summons 1 bee to help u and it dies after 5s.

Chrono records all the damages and break out with 1.2x after 5s,or it can be triggered in advance with another hit.

Dusklight shoots 5 arrows 1 time which causes 30% each and cause extra 100% when 5 arrows hit the same entity.

Singularity causes a black hole which pulls every entity in 5 blocks for 5s,when it ends and at least 3 entitys are in 3x3x3,it will explode,and each entity add extra 5 damage.

whistlingarrow:

this "bow" shots one arrow which is controlled by ur crosshair.

The quiver's ability:

Magicquiver enables u to use :weapon items as arrows.I changed the arrow's chartlet so u can see the swords or anything else with "damage" being shot out by the bow.(The swords' enchantments can still work btw)
